figures.caption: A complete map head describes its children without validating them.
figures.alt: Four details at after_h_success show the completed head instruction, success and width two, major type five and argument four, and input starting b8 04 before the map contents.

figures.caption: The walker retains its open-container depth before visiting a child.
figures.alt: Four details at after_k_depth show an observation nop, retained depth one in s2 and element count one in s4, and input 81 80 followed by untouched backing bytes.

figures.caption: Successful decoding publishes active fields while preserving their unused tails.
figures.alt: Five details at after_d_payload show successful decoding of fifty-two bytes, the full-width little-endian counter, identifier length three and reading count ten, identifier 00 ff 41, ten signed samples, and unchanged logical and physical tails.

figures.caption: The pipeline validates optional metadata and emits the required fields in deterministic form.
figures.alt: Four details at results_ready show success and output length thirty-seven, the original fifty-two-byte four-pair map, and a three-pair deterministic encoding ending before its unchanged backing suffix.
